description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Probes carry target_hw = NULL_MAC (six zero octets) (RFC 3927 §2.2.1, SHOULD)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.2.1 says the Probe's ARP target_hw SHOULD be all zeros — the prober is asking 'who has this IP?' and does not know (or care about) any target hardware address. Setting target_hw to a real MAC would be misleading. This case observes the first DUT-emitted Probe and asserts target_hw is six zero octets.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Probe (the first one)
     - ARP target_hw == 00:00:00:00:00:00   ← key check

[Pass condition]
First DUT Probe carries ARP target_hw = NULL_MAC.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_target_hw_not_zero — Probe target_hw is not the null MAC
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted Probe has target_hw = NULL_MAC — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
